title: Southern Gentlemen Fishing Charters
specs: Guided by a fourth-generation Florida native with over 30 years experience
Use of specialized Maverick Master Angler boat for shallow inshore and backcountry fishing
Focus on stealth, strategy, and conservation in fishing for species like Snook, Redfish, Tarpon
Kid-friendly trips with patient, gentle boating skills and safe, comfortable experience
No weight or height limits stated
Up to 3 anglers included in base price; $50 per additional angler
blurb: Guests fish for inshore species like Snook, Redfish, Tarpon, Seatrout, Black Drum, Snapper, and Sharks aboard a specialized Maverick Master Angler boat. The experience emphasizes stealth, strategy, and conservation, with expert guidance from a fourth-generation Florida native. Trips are tailored to skill level and focus on a refined sporting pursuit rather than a simple boat ride.
extraNote: Non-refundable credit card deposit of minimum $100 to reserve trip · Cancellations must be requested at least two weeks prior to trip date for full refund of deposit · Balance payable on day of trip by credit card, debit card, PayPal, cash, or by check one week prior
